request.style: English, male baritone, solo with choral backing, harp, organ, strings, slow hymn, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder
He paid the king of Israel every year
A hundred thousand lambs was the tribute
And wool from a hundred thousand rams

[Verse]
But when Ahab died the bond was broken
The king of Moab rebelled against Israel
The sheep breeder stopped his payment
And the sheep breeder refused the heavy load

[Verse]
The tribute of lambs was no longer paid
The wool of the rams stayed in his fold
He rebelled against the king of Israel
And the sheep breeder held his ground

[Outro]
He rebelled against the king
